model_organism.citation: The KLF7/PFKL/ACADL axis modulates cardiac metabolic remodelling during cardiac hypertrophy in male mice (PMID: 36810848)
phenotypes: Cardiac-specific knockout KLF7 induces adult concentric hypertrophy
Cardiac-specific overexpression KLF7 induces infant eccentric hypertrophy
Altered glycolysis and fatty acid oxidation fluxes

model_organism.citation: KLF7 orchestrates hippocampal development through neurogenesis and Draxin-mediated neuronal migration (PMID: 40762575)
Krüppel like factor 7 regulates mitochondrial dynamics balance in myocardial infarction (PMID: 40346382)
phenotypes: Cardiomyocyte-specific knockout Klf7 significantly lowered mortality of MI-inflicted mice
Cardiomyocyte-specific overexpression Klf7 aggravated adverse cardiac remodeling

model_organism.citation: Krüppel-like factor 7 deficiency causes autistic-like behavior in mice via regulating Clock gene (PMID: 36207723)
phenotypes: Downregulated Clock gene expression in brain

model_organism.citation: Brn3a and Klf7 cooperate to control TrkA expression in sensory neurons (PMID: 17011544)
phenotypes: Single Klf7-/- mice show only slightly decreased TrkA expression at E12.5
Double mutant Brn3a-/-;Klf7-/- shows severely reduced TrkA expression at E12.5
All Trk(+) neurons lost in Brn3a-/-;Klf7-/- trigeminal ganglia at birth
TrkA enhancer inactive in double mutant

model_organism.citation: Identification of genes regulated by transcription factor KLF7 in differentiating olfactory sensory neurons (PMID: 17123745)
phenotypes: Affected genes involved in OSN differentiation
Downregulation of OMP and L1 adhesion molecule

model_organism.citation: Transcription factor KLF7 regulates differentiation of neuroectodermal and mesodermal cell lineages (PMID: 20580711)
phenotypes: Decreased expression of neuronal marker MAP2
Reduced NGF tyrosine kinase receptor A (TrkA) expression
Decreased expression of BLBP/FABP7 in neural stem cells
Impaired neuronal differentiation of embryonic stem cells
Impaired cardiomyocytic differentiation of embryonic stem cells
Altered adipogenic and osteogenic potential of mouse embryonic fibroblasts

model_organism.citation: Transcription factor KLF7 is important for neuronal morphogenesis in selected regions of the nervous system (PMID: 15964824)
phenotypes: Axonal misprojection at selected anatomical locations
Downregulation of p21waf/cip and p27kip1 genes in olfactory epithelium
p21waf/cip and p27kip1 accumulation in cytoplasm of differentiating olfactory sensory neurons

model_organism.citation: The zinc finger transcription factor Klf7 is required for TrkA gene expression and development of nociceptive sensory neurons (PMID: 15937222)
phenotypes: Significant reduction in sensory neurons due to increased apoptosis
Neuronal loss restricted to nociceptive neurons
Reduced TrkA expression in sensory neurons
Other somatosensory neuron populations appear normal

model_organism.citation: Kruppel-like factor 7 overexpression suppresses hematopoietic stem and progenitor cell function (PMID: 22936656)
phenotypes: Klf7(-/-) cells show comparable long-term multilineage engraftment with control cells
Self-renewal not affected in Klf7(-/-) cells
KLF7 overexpression results in marked suppression of myeloid progenitor cell growth
Loss of short- and long-term repopulating activity with KLF7 overexpression
Multilineage growth suppression extending to hematopoietic stem cells and common lymphoid progenitors
T cells spared and early thymocyte survival enhanced with KLF7 overexpression

biological.citation: KLF7 regulates super-enhancer-driven IGF2BP2 overexpression to promote the progression of head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (PMID: 38443991)
biological.summary: KLF7 acts as a transcriptional activator that directly binds to the promoter and super-enhancer regions of IGF2BP2, driving its overexpression in HNSCC. KLF7 expression positively correlates with IGF2BP2 abundance, and patients with high expression of both genes show poorer prognosis.

biological.citation: HMGB1-mediated elevation of KLF7 facilitates hepatocellular carcinoma progression and metastasis through upregulating TLR4 and PTK2 (PMID: 37554278)
biological.summary: KLF7 is upregulated by HMGB1 through the TLR4/RAGE-PI3K-AKT-NF-κB pathway and acts as a transcriptional activator of TLR4 and PTK2, forming an HMGB1-KLF7-TLR4 positive feedback loop that promotes HCC metastasis. KLF7 expression correlates with poor prognosis in HCC patients.

biological.citation: KLF7-regulated ITGA2 as a therapeutic target for inhibiting oral cancer stem cells (PMID: 40316546)
biological.summary: KLF7 directly regulates ITGA2 expression through binding to its promoter, maintaining cancer stem cell stemness in OSCC. ITGA2 knockdown impairs stemness, and ITGA2-collagen interaction activates PI3K-AKT, MAPK, and Hippo signaling pathways critical for stemness maintenance.
biological.sample_size: OSCC cell lines (SCC9, CAL27) and xenograft models

biological.citation: KLF7 Promotes Hepatocellular Carcinoma Progression Through Regulating SLC1A5-Mediated Tryptophan Metabolism (PMID: 39648156)
biological.summary: KLF7 directly binds to the SLC1A5 promoter and upregulates its expression, promoting tryptophan metabolism and serotonin production in HCC cells. KLF7-mediated SLC1A5 upregulation drives HCC cell proliferation and migration.
biological.sample_size: HCC cell lines and xenograft models

biological.citation: KLF7 promotes colon adenocarcinoma progression through the PDGFB signaling pathway (PMID: 38164176)
biological.summary: KLF7 directly binds to the PDGFB promoter (TGGGTGGAG motif) and promotes PDGFB transcription and secretion, which activates MAPK/ERK, PI3K/AKT, and JAK/STAT3 signaling pathways to drive COAD progression and metastasis.
biological.sample_size: COAD tissues and cell lines with xenograft models

biological.citation: KLF7 promotes neuroblastoma differentiation through the GTPase signaling pathway by upregulating neuroblast differentiation-associated protein AHNAKs and glycerophosphodiesterase GDPD5 (PMID: 38924469)
biological.summary: KLF7 is a neuroblastoma super-enhancer-associated transcription factor that promotes neuroblastoma differentiation independently and cooperatively with retinoic acid by directly binding to promoters of AHNAK, AHNAK2, and GDPD5. High KLF7 expression is associated with favorable neuroblastoma prognosis.
biological.sample_size: Neuroblastoma cell lines and clinical samples

biological.citation: KLF7 promotes progression of Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma by remodeling tumor immune microenvironment (PMID: 41482204)
biological.summary: KLF7 directly transcriptionally activates LOX expression in HNSCC cells, which drives extracellular matrix crosslinking to create a stiff microenvironment that recruits tumor-associated macrophages and suppresses CD8+ T cell-mediated killing, promoting HNSCC progression.
biological.sample_size: HNSCC cell lines and xenograft models

biological.citation: KLF7 orchestrates hippocampal development through neurogenesis and Draxin-mediated neuronal migration (PMID: 40762575)
biological.summary: KLF7 is essential for hippocampal development, regulating neurogenesis and neuronal migration by directly activating Draxin, a neural chemorepellent. KLF7 deletion in hippocampal progenitors causes hippocampal shrinkage, abnormal neuronal projections, and behavioral/cognitive deficits in conditional knockout mice.

biological.citation: KLF7 promotes adipocyte inflammation and glucose metabolism disorder by activating the PKCζ/NF-κB pathway (PMID: 37342904)
biological.summary: KLF7 upregulates PKCζ expression through direct promoter binding and activates the PKCζ/NF-κB pathway to promote IL-6 expression in adipocytes. KLF7 fat conditional knockout mice show decreased PKCζ, p-IκB, p-p65, and IL-6 expression in white adipose tissue.
biological.sample_size: 3T3-L1 adipocytes, HEK-293T cells, and KLF7 fat conditional knockout mice

biological.citation: KLF7 as a biomarker for the pre-metastatic state promotes colorectal cancer liver metastasis via TGFβ autocrine signaling (PMID: 41213461)
biological.summary: KLF7 is a key biomarker of pre-metastatic state cells and promotes epithelial-mesenchymal transition in colorectal cancer by activating TGFβ autocrine signaling, facilitating colorectal cancer liver metastasis. EGCG inhibits KLF7 transcriptional activity to suppress TGFβ signaling.
biological.sample_size: Human cell lines, bulk RNA-seq, single-cell sequencing, and spatial transcriptomics data

biological.citation: ASHG 2016 - De novo alterations in KLF7 are a novel cause of intellectual disability, psychiatric and neuromuscular issues (D.N. Shinde et al.)
biological.summary: De novo missense mutations in KLF7 (c.410C>T p.T137M, c.415C>T p.P139S in F-box motif; c.790G>A p.D264N in zinc finger DNA-binding domain) cause intellectual disability, abnormal muscle tone, feeding difficulties, psychiatric features, and neuromuscular issues, establishing KLF7 as a developmental disease gene.
biological.sample_size: 3 unrelated affected individuals with de novo KLF7 alterations
